verdict.rationale: Eqvista is an equity management and valuation platform, so international valuations and country-specific option plans are a fair question for it. However, every valuation and compliance item in the evidence is US-specific: 409A valuations, FMV, ASC 718, Rule 701, Form 3921, and LLC/S-Corp support. Nothing mentions UK HMRC/EMI valuations or non-US option schemes.
